assumptions.target: binary and fixed within the two-step sensing episode
assumptions.initial_prior: T and C0 independent fair bits
assumptions.routing_observation: binary symmetric channel with P(R=C0)=a, a in [1/2,1]
assumptions.specialist_observations: independent binary symmetric channels around the deterministic specialist outputs with reliability b in [1/2,1]

evolutionary_corollary: with fitness value v per accuracy unit and routing-control cost k, DeltaW = v*gain-k; cue reliabilities are complementary conditional on nonzero temporal predictability
test_status: Repository test file added. Local git clone for branch-wide pytest was blocked by DNS in the execution environment; GitHub Actions is the intended full-suite check.
claim_boundary: Exact only for the stated symmetric binary-noise model; no general factorization claim for asymmetric, correlated, multistep, or nonbinary cue processes.
